name: Traveller's Burr
notes: A shoulder-high weed whose seed case is a hooked burr, and whose whole method is other people's journeys. It does not grow where the wind blows; it grows where somebody walked, because a hem, a fleece or a dog carried it there and it dropped off when they stopped. A drover who has crossed the ford picks a dozen out of the animals on the far side, and plants next year's stand doing it.
journal_prompt: Hooked green cases at the height of a knee, and three of them already on your hem. You did not notice picking them up and you will not notice putting them down.
